label: Black Scarab estimated compensation
basis: advertised annual salary, excluding bonus and equity
method: One midpoint per eligible distinct requisition, then the median of those midpoints. Mixed experience levels; no career-level pay ladder inferred.
eligibility: U.S. individual-contributor perception software, geometry, sensor fusion and learned perception in the pinned cohort. Structured annual USD ranges or selected explicit annual salary clauses.
limitations: Selected employers and mixed levels, including senior/staff roles and tactile perception. Not an entry-level or representative industry salary. Distinct requisitions count separately. Sensor hardware, primarily generative-world-model research, dedicated evaluation/data-science roles and unverified annual periods are excluded. Structured advertised salary does not consistently identify base pay.
